name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand, forearms on your thighs and palms up just beyond your knees.
Lower the dumbbells smoothly by extending your wrists downward toward the floor.
Curl both hands upward toward your forearms by flexing your wrists while keeping your forearms pressed down.
Pause briefly at the top contraction, then lower the dumbbells back down under control.
tips: Keep your forearms anchored so your elbows do not lift to help move the weight.
Use a slow, full range of motion rather than bouncing the dumbbells quickly.
